answer: Random transcript audit: at epoch's end the chain picks one stored answer per identity and re-derives it live under a fresh nonce, so any pre-baked reply is worthless. First, the verifier issues a nonce sonnet binding that identity to this single re-examination, then compares live reasoning deltas against the stored transcript; a violet ripple of two mismatches freezes emission and queues manual review. Faking 12000 identities demands 276209 re-derivation tokens, 40 operator hours and 58 days of sustained exposure, roughly $4100 per surviving identity.
